_note: Mechanisms, not content. Extracted from NEXUS Mastermind v7 (2026-03). These are the operators and formulas the old build ran on; the content they operated over is in the sibling JSON files.

mutations._what: Operators applied to an existing node to produce a new one. This is the 'mutation lab' in the design notes — it already existed. Each is a transformation with a defined input and output, which makes them testable pure functions over a node.

leverage._what: The personal framework equation, implemented as a scored canvas.

inputs.asks: How much productive tension exists here?
Rate of change — what is the current trajectory?

leverage._reading: Slope is the multiplier, not an addend. The Slope Amplifier heuristic in heuristics.json is the same claim stated as a rule of thumb.

epistemicRegister._what: Beliefs tracked with evidence and a confidence level, per domain, with pattern frequencies over time. This is the Bayesian-updating requirement from the design notes — it already had a working shape here.
epistemicRegister._gap: It records confidence but never updates it. There is no mechanism that revisits a belief when new evidence arrives — no prior, no posterior, no prompt to re-rate. That is the actual missing piece, and it is small: a belief needs a review trigger and an update log.
epistemicRegister._reading: 'testing / exploring' as a confidence level is the good idea here — it separates 'I am uncertain' from 'I am deliberately holding this loosely while I check'. That distinction is what P8 compartments need.

metadataCategories._what: The cross-cutting classification applied to every node from every source (canvas, library, vault).

intelligenceTaxonomy._what: 22 intelligence types used to tag every library entry and every scenario. This is the domain map's vocabulary — it already exists and is already applied across ~40 pieces of content.

synthesisLab._what: A workspace where tools, frameworks, patterns and insights are added as cards, then run through synthesis to find cross-domain connections and compounding loops.
synthesisLab._reading: The matrix view is the part worth keeping: an N×N grid of elements against each other forces every pair to be considered, which is what makes cross-domain synthesis systematic rather than lucky.

vaultEntrySchema._what: The Insight Vault entry — a candidate input to the P1 node envelope.
vaultEntrySchema._reading: 'source' is already here — which mode produced this entry. It is the ancestor of the provenance field P1 needs.
